name: jira
label: Jira
description: Turns Jira ticket keys (PAY-412) into links to your Jira site, reads ticket URLs of that site, and shows the ticket and its comments through Atlassian's CLI (acli).

requires.name: acli
install: set -eu; v=1.3.40-stable; a=$(dpkg --print-architecture); case "$a" in amd64) s=19c113789e8a66bf11a80dc18cf75e7e7ba239112005f4e9cd69db05f11ac526;; arm64) s=b1880f66f299ab2b56528c90bbff50ca8263e7331868a31d0b6ca7b67f7469e5;; *) echo "no acli build for $a" >&2; exit 1;; esac; t=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT; curl -fsSL -o "$t/acli.tgz" "https://acli.atlassian.com/linux/$v/acli_${v}_linux_$a.tar.gz"; echo "$s  $t/acli.tgz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xzf "$t/acli.tgz" -C "$t"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; install -m 0755 "$t/acli_${v}_linux_$a/acli" "$HOME/.local/bin/acli"

instructions.macos: brew tap atlassian/homebrew-acli && brew install acli
instructions.linux: See https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/acli/guides/install-linux/ (apt, yum or a direct download)
